published.en: Participants must be at least 16 years old AND live in the neighborhood. Registration must be received on or before 5 November 2026 at 18:00 UTC.
published.es: Para participar, hay que tener al menos 16 años Y residir en el barrio. La inscripción debe recibirse a más tardar el 5 de noviembre de 2026 a las 18:00 UTC.

alice.text: Participation policy. Age means completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. Normally an applicant is eligible only if they are a resident and are between 20 and 45 years old, inclusive. There is one exception to the residency requirement: a nonresident is eligible if and only if they are between 28 and 32 years old, inclusive. Nobody outside their applicable age range is eligible. The application system must record the submission at or before 2027-11-17T14:10:00Z (UTC), including that instant. Acceptance requires eligibility and compliance with this deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.

bob.text: Política de participación. Una persona solicitante es elegible si y solo si es residente y tiene al menos 22 años. La edad se mide en años completos en el instante de presentación registrado. Normalmente el sistema debe registrar la presentación a más tardar el 2027-11-17T14:10:00Z (UTC), incluido ese instante. Sin embargo, se exime por completo del plazo a las personas residentes que tengan al menos 60 años: sus presentaciones se aceptan sin importar el instante registrado. Para todas las demás personas, la aceptación exige tanto elegibilidad como cumplimiento del plazo. No hay otras condiciones ni excepciones.

candidates.es: Política de participación. La edad se mide en años completos en el instante de presentación registrado. Normalmente, una persona solicitante es elegible únicamente si es residente y tiene entre 20 y 45 años, ambos inclusive. Hay una excepción al requisito de residencia: una persona no residente es elegible si y solo si tiene entre 28 y 32 años, ambos inclusive. Nadie que esté fuera de su intervalo de edad aplicable es elegible. El sistema de solicitudes debe registrar la presentación a más tardar el 2027-11-17T14:10:00Z (UTC), incluido ese instante. La aceptación exige elegibilidad y cumplimiento de este plazo. No hay otras condiciones ni excepciones.
issues: The policy imposes maximum ages of 45 for residents and 32 for nonresidents; maximum-age predicates are unsupported.

The residency-dependent age ranges and nonresident exception cannot be represented by a single minimum-age predicate and an optional positive residency predicate joined by AND or OR. A fully supported policy or an expanded rule schema is required.

candidates.en: Participation policy. An applicant is eligible if and only if they are a resident and at least 22 years old. Age is measured in completed whole years at the recorded submission timestamp. Normally, the system must record the submission no later than 2027-11-17T14:10:00Z (UTC), including that instant. However, residents who are at least 60 years old are completely exempt from the deadline: their submissions are accepted regardless of the recorded timestamp. For everyone else, acceptance requires both eligibility and compliance with the deadline. There are no other conditions or exceptions.

issues: Residents aged 60 or older bypass the deadline. The schema always ANDs a single deadline with eligibility and cannot represent an age-dependent deadline exemption; this exception must be clarified within a supported policy or represented by an expanded rule schema.
